## Professional Summary
Associate AI Engineer specializing in Agentic AI architectures, LLM Integrations, Multi-Agent Orchestration, RAG Pipelines, and Model Context Protocol (MCP). Experienced in building high-performance full-stack web applications, backend microservices, and automated document intelligence platforms.
